title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management Functional Consultant
description:
**Dear Candidates,**

**Greetings From VThrive Solutions !!**

**Exciting Opportunity For Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management – Functional Consultant !!**

Are you a passionate professional with expertise in **Oracle Fusion Cloud Finance Functional Consultant ?** experience in Oracle ERP implementations, with strong expertise in **Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management** will be responsible for requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, implementation, and production support.

**What we are looking For** : We are looking for an experienced **Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management Functional Consultant** with **7–10 Years** of experience in Oracle ERP implementations, with strong expertise in **Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management (PJM)**. The consultant will be responsible for requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, implementation, and production support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead functional activities for **Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management** implementations and support projects.
* Gather and analyze business requirements from project management, finance, and business stakeholders.
* Configure Oracle Fusion **Project Management, Project Costing, Project Billing, and Project Foundation** modules.
* Design project structures, project templates, project types, classifications, and business processes.
* Configure **project costing, burdening, accounting, billing, revenue recognition, and invoicing** processes.
* Work with Finance teams on integration with **General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, and Procurement**.
* Configure project\-related setups including **transaction controls, expenditure types, organizations, resources, and project classifications**.
* Handle **project budgets, forecasts, funding, commitments, and project performance reporting**.
* Support integration requirements with other Oracle Fusion modules and third\-party applications.
* Prepare functional specifications for reports, integrations, conversions, and extensions.
* Work with technical teams on **OTBI, BI Publisher, FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** requirements.
* Conduct functional testing, including **SIT, UAT, regression testing**, and defect resolution.
* Prepare test scenarios, test scripts, configuration documents, and user training materials.
* Provide production support and troubleshoot functional issues.
* Participate in implementation activities including **CRP, conference room pilots, cutover, and go\-live support**.
* Coordinate with offshore/onshore teams and business stakeholders.

**Required Skills**

* **7–10 years of Oracle ERP/Fusion Cloud functional experience.**
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management**.
* Good knowledge of:
* Oracle Project Foundation
* Oracle Project Costing
* Oracle Project Billing
* Project Accounting
* Project Planning and Budgeting
* Project Contracts/Funding
* Project Performance
* Strong understanding of **Oracle Fusion Financials** and project\-to\-finance integration.
* Experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation/support projects.
* Strong knowledge of business process mapping and functional configuration.
* Experience preparing **BRD, FSD, test scripts, configuration documents, and training documents**.
* Good understanding of Oracle Fusion reporting tools such as **OTBI and BI Publisher**.
* Knowledge of **FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs, and OIC** is an advantage.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud certification in **Project Management / Financials**.
* Experience in at least one or more **end\-to\-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations**.
* Knowledge of **Project Portfolio Management (PPM)** processes.
* Experience working in Agile and/or Oracle implementation methodologies.
* Ability to independently manage functional workstreams and guide junior consultants.

**Key Deliverables**

* Business requirements and solution design documents
* Functional configuration and setup
* Functional specifications
* Test scenarios and scripts
* Data migration/conversion support
* Integration requirements
* UAT and defect resolution
* User training and knowledge\-transfer documents
* Go\-live and post\-production support

**Open Positions :**  
We're hiring talented professionals at various experience levels. Preference will be given to those available for **immediate joining**.

**Apply Now !**  
Send your updated CV with your CTC details to: **srinivasm@vthrivesolutions.com**

Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity. Let’s create transformative solutions together!

**Thanks\&Regards,**

**Srinivas,**

title: Product/Project Manager
description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.


At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life\-changing career.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The **Product/Project Manager** is responsible forresponsible for leading large and complex projects or programs from concept through execution and customer handover. The role ensures delivery of scope, schedule, quality, cost, and customer requirements while coordinating cross\-functional teams across engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, quality, and service functions.


This position reports to the Senior Engineering Managerand is part of the Custom Engineering organization located in **Pune** and will be an on\-site role.At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.

**What will you do:**

* Project Leadership: Lead multiple projects/programs; define scope, objectives, deliverables; develop plans, schedules, budgets and resources; drive execution from initiation to closure.
* Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-Functional Coordination: Interface with customers, engineering, operations, supply chain and leadership; conduct project reviews; manage communications. Work with Mechanical, Electrical \& Controls, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Validation and Service teams.
* Schedule \& Cost Management: Track milestones, budgets, forecasts and risks to maintain delivery commitments.
* Risk \& Change Management: Maintain risk registers, contingency plans and change\-control processes. Manage FAT and SAT and handle customer complaints
* Quality, Compliance \& EHS: Ensure compliance with quality standards, GMP, safety and DBS continuous improvement practices.

**Who are you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of project management experience.
* Experience in life sciences, biopharma, filtration systems, skids, process equipment or capital projects.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* ERP experience such as Oracle or SAP.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

**About Us**

Tata Consulting Engineers Limited (TCE) is the largest Indian private sector engineering and project consultancy and an emerging global leader in integrated engineering solutions. With more than 60 years of engineering excellence, TCE has a presence in over 64 countries and over 12000 completed projects, the company operates in 3 core Industry segments \-Infrastructure (Water, Environment, Urban Development, Buildings, Manufacturing Facilities, Ports and Harbours, Transportation), Power (Thermal, Hydro, Nuclear, Renewable, Transmission and Distribution) and Resources \- Hydrocarbons and Chemicals (Oil, Gas and Refineries, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Fertilizers, Speciality Chemicals, Pulp and Paper, Cement, Food, Pharmaceuticals and Beverages, Tyre, Glass) as well as Mining and Metallurgy (Mining, Geology, Beneficiation, Steel, Non\-ferrous). TCE serves domestic as well as international markets and is known for several first\-of\-its\-kind projects offering Engineering Studies, Design Engineering Services, Project Management Consultancy Services, OPEX and IIOT across all three verticals. A part of Tata Group \- India’s most respected group, TCE is a 100 percent subsidiary of Tata Sons Limited Design your Future with us At TCE, you will experience a supportive environment that empowers you to excel, whether you are based in our offices or at a client site. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering a workplace where every individual can thrive by contributing their unique skills and perspectives to deliver exceptional results for our clients. Our comprehensive compensation and benefits packages are designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families, complemented by a robust global well\-being program. As a leading global infrastructure firm, we are committed to your growth and success, offering access to cutting\-edge technology and impactful projects that offer flexibility and significant professional opportunities. Join us and become part of a global company that values your potential and supports your career development.
**Purpose \& Scope of Position**
--------------------------------


The Planning Engineer is responsible for the delivery of project planning and progress measurement, ensuring that TCE’s procedures and best practices are applied, as appropriate, and recommending changes to the Project Controls Manager where required. He is responsible for developing and maintaining the project master schedule to meet the project objectives.
**Experience**
--------------


• Working knowledge of engineering, project control systems and construction management. • 2\+ years of relevant experience as a planner in a multi discipline project environment • Knowledge in the use of Primavera Project Planner and MS Office package
**Qualification**
-----------------


• Postgraduate or graduate in an engineering discipline • Professional Project Management Certification (preferable from PMI) or Post Graduate degree in Project Engineering and Management or Post Graduate degree in Advanced Construction Management
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\.Conduct planning meeting with Functional Managers to finalize project implementation schedule 2\.Create detailed logic linked project plans around project WBS in primavera or by using various Microsoft tools 3\.Monitor plans to ensure that the processes relating project planning to detailed planning are being adhered to 4\.Manage and control the project schedule against base line conditions, including staff, production and materials 5\.Confirm project schedules and critical paths and set baseline for project implementation phase 6\.Generate and verify weekly updates and issue progress reports 7\.Participate in project schedule risk analysis and include resultant contingency in baseline 8\.Using progress reports (early and late curves) and project schedule. maintain, optimize and monitor progress. Identify and resolve issues 9\.Monitor slippages of critical and near critical paths and discuss with Project Controls Engineer/Project Manager for resolution 10\.Ensures the integrity of the project schedule through approved scope changes, fiscal changes and contingency reallocations 11\.Re\-base line the plan(s) following a major contract change, to create a revised, viable programme of work for the remaining tasks 12\.Once a change is approved, maintain and optimize the schedule, monitor progress and highlight/ resolve areas of potential concern. 13\.Ensures the project cost reports include schedule adjustments that could affect the forecast final costs 14\.Analyse, interpret and report on key performance indicators such as earned value, schedule performance indicators, cost performance indicators and forecast cost at completion date 15\.Facilitate exchange of information between Project Manager and Project Controls Engineer 16\.Communicate cost and schedule risk reports to Project Controls Engineer contributing to recovery and improvement initiatives

----------------

description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.


At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life\-changing career.
